summary: fix(auth): stop reading subscriptions in GET /v1/account
description:
Because:

* GET /v1/account read Stripe, Play and the App Store on every
  Settings load, only to show or hide one nav link

This commit:

* Stops GET /v1/account from reading and returning subscriptions
* Always shows the Paid Subscriptions link in the Settings nav
* Removes subscriptions from the Settings account model and state

Closes FXA-14660
